limitations.title: Zero genuine RTK integer ambiguity resolution (FIX = 0.0%)
limitations.description: Across 52 full-24h B-02 RTKLIB runs (149,760 epochs) and all Phase 3/5 baselines, genuine centimetre RTK FIX rate is 0.0%. Experimental VRS phases remain ANCHOR_RELATIVE_FLOAT without network double-difference IAR.

limitations.title: Provisional 2011 OSGoF coordinate provenance (no verified ITRF realization or offline 2011 PPP products)
limitations.description: All 11 stations in NIGNET2011.zip have OSGoF 2011-01-01 coordinates lacking documented ITRF realization, ARP continuity, and uncertainty. Zero 2011 SP3/CLK/ERP/OSB products exist on disk, blocking offline PRIDE PPP-AR verification.

limitations.title: Single-day verified 2024 coordinate scope and sparse 3-reference extrapolation geometry
limitations.description: Only DOY 2024/026 admits 4 verified IGS20 stations (ABFC, EKAK, MGBO, PHRI, 105-1,029 km spacing), forcing extrapolation in every held-out rotation and causing -0.53 fewer satellites/epoch on 2024 atmospheric VRS.

limitations.title: Offline non-causal atmospheric arc leveling (no real-time causal filter)
limitations.description: common_arc_sd_l1_iono and nighttime_leveled_sd_l1_iono use full-day carrier-phase arc medians/nighttime windows, incorporating future epochs from the same day. Not directly deployable in real-time causal streaming.

limitations.title: No authorized live or recorded authentic Nigerian CORS / NTRIP stream
limitations.description: Zero authorized live or recorded authentic RTCM/NTRIP streams exist under /home/excellence/nlgcp-data; Phases 9, 10, 11, and 12 remain synthetically validated only for transport/encoding.

limitations.title: No independent non-RTKLIB RTCM MSM4 (1074/1084) decoder or second positioning engine
limitations.description: ESA/gAGE-UPC gLAB v6.0.0 cross-decoded CRC-24Q and RTCM 1005 only; MSM4 (1074/1084) is unsupported by gLAB v6.0.0. All MSM4 decoding and rover positioning relies exclusively on RTKLIB v2.4.2-p13.

limitations.title: GPS-only VRS streams and missing GLONASS FCN/1230/antenna RTCM messages
limitations.description: Experimental VRS emits GPS-only RTCM 1005+1074; standalone synthetic RTCM 1084 lacks GLONASS FCN/1020/1230 (yielding L_cyc=0 in RTKLIB without external FCN); 1006/1007/1008/1033/Galileo/BeiDou are unimplemented.

limitations.title: Day 7 security blockers forbid non-loopback deployment (SEC-01..SEC-10)
limitations.description: 14 security/reliability findings (2 CRITICAL, 4 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 3 LOW, 1 INFO) including plaintext Basic/SOURCE auth, static in-memory credentials, missing pre-auth connection limits, missing Go HTTP timeouts, and Compose default passwords block any non-127.0.0.1 exposure.
affected_claims: Production or controlled-network NTRIP caster readiness

limitations.title: Zero hardware-in-loop (HIL) or field rover validation
limitations.description: No commercial GNSS receiver testing, surveyed Nigerian control-point validation, or field campaign has been performed (Phase 16 Not Started).

limitations.title: Missing external DCB/IONEX products and incomplete WUM product retention
limitations.description: external-products/igs/2024/ contains zero files (no external DCB or IONEX). In 2024 PRIDE working runs, WUM0MGXRAP ORB.SP3 persists while companion CLK/BIA/ERP were converted/cleaned into internal PRIDE files.
affected_claims: Standalone raw WUM archive replay without re-download

limitations.title: Equatorial post-sunset scintillation and single-day seasonal coverage
limitations.description: B-02 tested one Harmattan day (2024-01-26) and one equinox day (2011-03-20). Post-sunset equatorial plasma-bubble activity (18-24 UTC, ROTI up to 3.07 TECU/min) still yielded 1.03-1.33 m kinematic H RMSE even with the best atmospheric VRS.

limitations.title: Provisional Phase 4 QC thresholds and incomplete early-phase CLI provenance
limitations.description: Phase 4 QC profile thresholds remain PROVISIONAL pending Level 3 Nigerian field calibration, and several early feature-branch pilots (Phases 3-8) did not record exact runtime shell invocation strings or environment snapshots uniformly.
affected_claims: Full Level-2 automated replay of early feature-branch pilots
